benchmark.method: One excluded fresh-process warmup per case/backend, then alternating backend and case order. No timing-based exclusions. Imports and input file loading are excluded; Validator construction/update, compute_metrics(extended=True), F1/IoU and cleanup are included. Separate extended-summary curve diagnostics are excluded. Whole-host telemetry includes worker startup and serialization.

input_provenance.image_selection: First N val2017 image IDs in ascending numeric order; no exclusions
input_provenance.annotation_policy: Unmodified D-FINE-seg Loader: crowds omitted, polygons rasterized; Validator does not receive original COCO area/iscrowd fields

cross_host_f1_audit.finding: Existing class-agnostic greedy F1 matching uses torch.argsort without stable=True. Bbox audit locates image 9400: candidates 14 and 18 have identical IoU 0.9155844449996948, but opposite tie order on the two platforms. Their labels are keyboard and laptop for the same keyboard GT. Both evaluator backends give the same F1 within each host; cross-host F1 differs by one TP. COCO mAP and full arrays are unaffected. No application sorting change was made.

mac_profile.method: One separate cProfile worker per backend after timed runs; excluded from benchmark summary. Same inputs and thread limits. Diagnostic attribution only.
